prompt.project_info: Editorial fashion photography of an adult fictional fashion model seated dynamically on a minimalist black stool in a high-key white cyclorama.
prompt.main_subject: Adult fictional woman with editorial charisma, wearing a light blue and orange architectural hooded technical jacket with 3D texture, asymmetrical zipper, straps, cordlocks, and pouches, matching tactical baggy pants, and high-cut blue-orange sneakers.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 seated portrait, torso twist, centered stool, clean white seamless cyclorama, full outfit visible, architectural silhouette and garment hardware as focal points.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Professional softbox lighting with ambient scattering, natural skin luminosity and authentic dermal texture, crisp technical fabric detail.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm analog film character, 85mm portrait lens look, sharp optical precision, realistic stitching, zippers, straps, and sneaker texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Editorial fashion photograph of a clearly adult fictional woman seated dynamically on a minimalist black stool, torso twisted with avant-garde attitude, wearing a light blue and orange architectural technical hooded jacket with 3D texture, asymmetrical zipper, straps, cordlocks and pouches, matching tactical baggy pants and high-cut blue-orange sneakers, high-key white cyclorama, softbox light, natural skin texture, 35mm analog film character, 85mm portrait lens, 9:16, no text or logos.
